verdict.rationale: Formant documents a broad programmatic surface: an Admin API with per-endpoint OpenAPI definitions and a live Try It console, a Cloud SDK for querying and ingesting data, and an Agent SDK for commands and teleop. Its docs say the APIs let you configure devices and design custom views, and custom commands are created through the Admin API. However, nothing states that every UI action is exposed via the API, and the full spec is admin-gated rather than downloadable. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, evidence that UI-only features (dashboards/analytics building, teleop view configuration, alerts setup) have API equivalents, a publicly downloadable complete API spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Formant's APIs and SDKs which allow you to programmatically ingest data, configure devices, design custom views and modules
you can create custom commands via the Formant Admin API
